# Middle School Close Reading Annotation Codes

Subject: ELA
Grade band: 6-8
Resource type: Annotation Guide
NYS framework label: NYS Next Generation ELA Learning Standards

## Short Description
A concise annotation key that keeps middle school close reading focused and consistent.

## Alignment Note
Supports analysis of theme, structure, word choice, and text-based discussion.

## Classroom Use Case
Project during first reads, then require students to use three codes before discussion.

## Preview Content
- T = theme clue
- ? = question or confusion
- W = word choice worth discussing

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
